units.source_text: 夏雨连绵，闲居无事之时，有一天中将教人拿了许多名贵的诗文集，来到二条院。

en.t: During a spell of continuous summer rain, when there was little to do in quiet retirement, the Lieutenant General one day had attendants bring many valuable collections of poetry and prose to the Nijo residence.

units.source_text: 源氏大将也命人打开殿内的书库，从以前未曾启封的书橱里选出若干世间罕有的珍本古集来。

en.t: General Genji also ordered the palace library opened, and from bookcases that had never before been unsealed he selected several rare old anthologies of a kind seldom seen in the world.

units.source_text: 并不大肆张扬，却召来了许多精通此道的人物。

en.t: He did not make a great show of it, but he summoned many people well versed in this art.

units.source_text: 也有殿上公卿，也有大学寮的博士，济济一堂，分为左右二列，相对而坐，竞赛掩韵。

en.t: There were court nobles admitted to the palace, and there were scholars from the Bureau of Education; all gathered together, divided into left and right rows, sat facing one another, and competed in the hidden-rhyme contest.

units.source_text: 奖品之精美，世无其匹，诸人争欲获得。

en.t: The prizes were so exquisite that nothing in the world could compare with them, and everyone eagerly competed to win them.

units.source_text: 这竞赛渐次进行下去，其间困难的韵字甚多，常常使得著名的博士周章狼狈。

en.t: As the contest gradually went on, many difficult rhyme words appeared, often throwing even famous scholars into confusion and embarrassment.

units.source_text: 源氏大将便时时加以指点。

en.t: General Genji would then offer guidance from time to time.
This showed clearly that his learning and talent were profound beyond compare.

units.source_text: 诸人啧啧赞叹，互相告道：“大将何以能有如此全才？定然前世福慧双修，故万事胜于常人。”

en.t: Everyone sighed in admiration and said to one another, "How can the General possess such all-around brilliance? Surely in a former life he cultivated both merit and wisdom, and that is why he surpasses ordinary people in everything."

units.source_text: 竞赛的结果，左方（源氏大将一方）得胜，右方（三位中将一方）认输。

en.t: As a result of the contest, the left side, General Genji's side, won, and the right side, the Third-Rank Lieutenant General's side, conceded defeat.

units.source_text: 过了两天之后，中将举办认输的飨宴。

en.t: Two days later, the Lieutenant General held the banquet of concession.

units.source_text: 排场并不十分铺张，然而种种食物非常精致，盛食物的桧木箱十分优美，还有各种各样的奖品。

en.t: The display was not especially extravagant, yet the various foods were extremely refined, the cypress boxes that held them were very beautiful, and there were all kinds of prizes as well.

units.source_text: 这一天照例聚集许多人物，大家作文吟诗。

en.t: On this day, as usual, many people gathered, and everyone composed prose and recited poetry.
